note: Written by the daily OpportunityHub scan. Facts come from official notifications.

openings.title: Engagement of Graduate Apprentices under Apprentices Act, 1961 for FY 2026-27
openings.location: All India (state-wise seats; Tamil Nadu 391, Kerala 240)
openings.qualification_text: Graduation in any discipline from a university recognised by Govt. of India (or equivalent), completed between 01.01.2023 and 01.09.2026 (both inclusive).
openings.age_limit_text: 20–28 years as on 01.09.2026 (born 02.09.1998 to 01.09.2006). Relaxation: SC/ST 5 yrs, OBC-NCL 3 yrs, PwBD 10 yrs; widows/divorced women up to 35/38/40 (Gen-EWS/OBC/SC-ST).
openings.salary_text: Stipend Rs. 16,650 per month (Bank Rs. 10,500 + Govt Rs. 6,150 via DBT); 12-month training.

other_requirements: 100% complete profile on NATS portal (nats.education.gov.in) with enrollment number before applying
Merit list state-wise from 12th/diploma marks; minimum 60% (55% SC/ST/PwBD)
Local language test at document verification if 10th/12th certificate does not show the opted local language

openings.ai_summary: Canara Bank is engaging about 3,500 graduate apprentices for a 12-month training under the Apprentices Act with a Rs. 16,650 monthly stipend, selected on 12th-standard marks without a written test. Graduates in any discipline who finished their degree between Jan 2023 and Sep 2026, aged 20–28 and registered on the NATS portal, can apply by 17 Oct 2026.
